name: personal-finance-planner
description: Goal-based financial planning with validated state, allocation policy, liquidity guidance, and deterministic calculators

interface.longDescription: Adds a deterministic coordination entry plus reusable progressive profile intake, explicit goal clarification and confirmation, financial-independence, structured goal-based target-allocation, cash-liquidity, and confirmed Workspace-state workflows. It packages versioned professional and regulatory sources, portable MCP prompts, allocation arithmetic and reference validation, deterministic real-value calculations, and a narrowly controlled external SQLite repository without packaging personal data, selecting products, or executing transactions.
defaultPrompt: Use $run-financial-planning to continue my plan from the right verified stage.
Use $financial-profile-intake to collect the minimum planning facts without inventing missing values.
Use $financial-goal-clarification to clarify and explicitly confirm financial goals before allocation.
